The night’s clouds part, and the moonlight is bright, casting the world in hues of purple and blue, in diminishing greys and in this moment you remember that this place was once wild.


A wolf howls. It's too close to be outside of the city. As your mind passively searches for the source, and the goosebumps begin to rise on your arms, the howl is returned by a chorus of dozens. Lights can be seen dancing. Small and yellow. No. Not lights. Eyes. Eyes of beasts running through the cobblestone streets and atop tiled roofs. 


A wolf stops in front of you about 100 yards out. It is smallish and grey, with eyes surely analyzing you yet fearless in nature. It lets out a billowing howl and you feel the primal cry in the core of you, the force of it giving meaning to instincts long dormant in humanoid species.


It pauses after the long low mournful sound, and makes eye contact again briefly before disappearing into the night

As you sketch and dream up player homes/shops build it for us in 3 phases. Week 3 will have its most basic and functional form. This is the hut or small cabin or small platform on a tree week. Rather than mansions or pirate ships. 

Week 4 gives you the beginning of improving it as its implied that you also work on it in your free time. This is the advanced roofing phase, the expanded walls and newer decorations, these are the new levels to your building.

Week 5 should be the piqued attainment of your concept, whether it's a humble wizard tower rising 50ft up, your fully actualized schooner to fish with, your 2 story house with a secret basement, or a fully furnished 3 bedroom cabin with a working sauna hut out back.

@everyone The sub has detected a small tropical island. It is surfacing now. Its time to get some rest and relaxation. This evening's event with DM Tao has been cancelled in order to give us some much lighter content.

@everyone We DMs are here to facilitate fun interactions and roleplay opportunities. We are committed to hearing player's preferences and critiques with an open ear and mind. This is the main reason why tonight's events will be nerfed, that we can hear a good percentage of players being stressed out. I'm glad to have you all playing the game we designed, but please be kind to one another (including the DMs) as we are all human and all have feelings, ambitions, limits and much more going on in our lives that doesn't happen in this game. Remember to practice self care as well. I, personally, had intended to be much more active when I began to write this campaign with Brendon, Noah and Rob at the very end of Season 2. Alas, my life (and I imagine most of yours) is much different than I had imagined it. So, this is my plea to let's all keep our perspective rooted in reality while having fun in game. This has been a DM TAO public service announcement.

@everyone I'd like to remind you to be good Allies to the non-binary players. Regardless of outside opinion, my game world includes non-binary identifying people as a fully normal and culturally acceptable. Take some care to the reminders that they patiently give to correct us and when corrected, I'd request that you edit your message. Additionally I'd like to lead by example by adding my pronouns to my name. There are some character name limits and if you would like  to add your pronouns too, H/H, S/H and T/T Can be used as He/ Him, She/Her or They/Them so as to not isolate our non-binaries as different. We care. We love you. And though I too make mistakes with misgendering, as a group we can all do better to be more inclusive.
